focus_area: Agent cost governance and continuous optimization
recommendation: Create systematic optimization feedback loops for continuous improvement
aws_service: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore / Amazon CloudWatch / AWS Cost Explorer
guidance: One-time optimization projects can miss compounding gains, as cost-performance characteristics of agent systems shift as prompts change, tools evolve, and traffic patterns drift. A monthly review cadence, A/B-tested changes, and cost gates in the deployment pipeline turn optimization into a continual practice that can keep pace with the system.
how_to_check: • You hold monthly cost optimization reviews following a structured agenda. • You A/B test cost-impacting changes through controlled traffic routing before fleet-wide promotion. • You calculate cost-quality efficiency ratios to prioritize optimizations by business value. • You have cost gates in deployment pipelines helping prevent accidental regressions. For more information, see the AGENTCOST07-BP03 documentation.
